description.value: Daves' Bakery is a well-regarded artisan bakery on Vancouver Island, recognized with a 2023 Restaurant Guru award, offering fresh-baked bread alongside coffee, tea, and cold drinks. The shop runs both a walk-in storefront and an online pre-order store. For a touring cyclist, it is a convenient food stop with baked goods and beverages available.
